verbatim_quote: An organisation must not transfer any personal data to a country or territory outside Singapore except in accordance with requirements prescribed under this Act to ensure that organisations provide a standard of protection to personal data so transferred that is comparable to the protection under this Act.
legal_rationale: The provision permits transfer subject to comparable-protection requirements, so it is a conditional flow regime rather than an outright transfer ban.

review.notes: Approved. Conditional-flow regime (transfer allowed subject to comparable-protection safeguards) -> 6.4, horizontal; score 1.0 reproduced by score_6_4 (has_conditional_flow + personal_data/horizontal). Wording confirmed against PDPC Transfer Limitation Obligation guidance; SSO spot-check pending (site blocks automated fetch). See docs/golden-set-legal-review-dossier.md.

verbatim_quote: An organisation must not transfer any personal data to a country or territory outside Singapore except in accordance with requirements prescribed under this Act to ensure that organisations provide a standard of protection to personal data so transferred that is comparable to the protection under this Act.
legal_rationale: The operative exception allows transfers that meet prescribed safeguards; it should not be coded as an outright ban or local-processing requirement.

review.notes: Approved negative. s.26 is a conditional regime, not an outright ban or local-processing rule, so score_6_1 finds no has_ban/has_local_processing -> 6.1 correctly scores 0.0. Boundary held by classifier fix PR #50.

verbatim_quote: An organisation must cease to retain its documents containing personal data, or remove the means by which the personal data can be associated with particular individuals, as soon as it is reasonable to assume that the purpose for which that personal data was collected is no longer being served by retention of the personal data and retention is no longer necessary for legal or business purposes.
legal_rationale: This is a retention-limitation rule and does not mandate a specified minimum retention period under indicator 7.3.

review.notes: Approved negative. s.25 is retention minimisation ('cease to retain once no longer necessary'), not a specified minimum period, so score_7_3 -> 0.0.

verbatim_quote: The company shall retain the records referred to in subsection (1) for seven years after the completion of the transactions or operations to which the entries relate.
legal_rationale: The provision imposes a specified seven-year minimum retention period on company accounting records.

review.notes: Approved. Subsection (3) seven-year minimum retention independently confirmed via SSM reprint and Malaysian practitioner sources -> 7.3 score 1.0. Scope 'sectoral' is descriptive only (7.3 score is scope-independent).

verbatim_quote: hold the records, or take the records, outside Australia
coverage_detail: Records in the My Health Record system
legal_rationale: The provision requires covered My Health Record records to be held within Australia, constituting a local-storage requirement.

review.notes: Approved (Q2, Q3). 'hold the records ... outside Australia' = local-storage limb -> 6.2; same personal_data=True basis (Q2). verbatim_quote: Before an APP entity discloses personal information about an individual to a person (the overseas recipient): (a) who is not in Australia or an external Territory; and (b) who is not the entity or the individual; the entity must take such steps as are reasonable in the circumstances to ensure that the overseas recipient does not breach the Australian Privacy Principles (other than Australian Privacy Principle 1) in relation to the information.
legal_rationale: APP 8.1 permits overseas disclosure subject to reasonable steps ensuring equivalent compliance, which is a conditional-flow obligation.

review.notes: Approved. Conditional cross-border disclosure -> 6.4, horizontal, score 1.0. Compilation C2026C00227 (2026-06-04), in force. Verbatim quote corrected to the official text incl. '(other than Australian Privacy Principle 1)' and the (a)/(b) structure (2026-07-13).

verbatim_quote: Every person carrying on or exercising any trade, business, profession or vocation must keep and retain in safe custody sufficient records for a period of 5 years from the year of assessment to which any income relates to enable the person's income and allowable deductions under this Act to be readily ascertained by the Comptroller or any officer authorised in that behalf by the Comptroller.
coverage_detail: Tax records for trades, businesses, professions and vocations
legal_rationale: The provision requires covered taxpayers to keep sufficient records for a specified five-year minimum period.

review.notes: Approved. Five-year record-keeping minimum for every trade/business/profession/vocation -> 7.3 score 1.0. Confirmed via PDPC/practitioner sources; SSO spot-check of the (1)(a) label pending (site blocks automated fetch).
